messages:
Tom: I opened a tiny PR that adds a migration guide for customers who want to move from vendor PKCS#11 paths -> use the Redwood PKCS11 shim. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5501. It includes: detection snippet, shim install steps for Windows+Linux, and a fallback plan.

Keiko: Nice. Can you summarize the detection approach? I want to include a one-liner in the quickstart.

Tom: Sure — the doc shows a 3-step detection: 1) check common vendor paths; 2) try `pkcs11-tool --module <path> -L`; 3) fall back to shim probe which exposes a `/health/pkcs11` endpoint. Example snippet in Python:```python
import os
paths=["/usr/lib/libyubihsm_pkcs11.so","C:\\Program Files\\YubiHSM\\pkcs11.dll"]
for p in paths:
  if os.path.exists(p):
    print('found',p)
```

Ravi: Good. For Windows pls include the MSI env var example and the exact order: vendor driver -> middleware -> shim -> restart agent. Lots of customers forget shim before agent.

Tom: Added MSI env var and vendor order. Also added an advisory: when using shim, preserve original vendor lib path and set Redwood agent env `REDWOOD_PKCS11_SHIM=/opt/redwood/pkcs11-shim.so` (Windows equivalent in MSI).

Keiko: Security: call out that shim should run as a restricted service account and that the shim must be deployed with file perms so only agent+ops can read the vendor key files. Can you add a minimal Windows ACL example?

Tom: Done, small icacls example and a Linux chown/chmod line.

link-bot: link-checker/5501 started. Found 1 broken anchor in hsm/appendix.md#pkcs11-windows-example -> suggest rename to pkcs11-shim-windows.

Tom: Fixed anchor and pushed. Also added a fallback plan: if shim probe fails, instruct customer to set `REDWOOD_PKCS11_LIB` manually and include a one-line checksum check for the shim binary.

Ravi: One tiny nit: replace generic "open ports" text in the shim deployment section. Use explicit wording: "allow egress to mirror host on port 443 for shim download and 445 for SMB mirrors as applicable".

Tom: Updated wording. Anyone available for a quick review? Hoping to merge today so support can reference it in migration tickets. :raised_hands:

Keiko: Quick pass: LGTM. Approve after link-checker green.

docs-bot: windows-smoke queued to verify shim smoke tests on branch. Will post results.

Tom: Thanks folks, I'll merge after smoke is green and open a companion snippets PR with the PowerShell MSI examples.
